_about: EVA toolbox curation. Keys are calls as listed in the toolbox (plugin: namespace.Function, vs-jetpack: module.function). hide = left out of the toolbox, with the reason. defaults = values used when the field is left empty (vs-jetpack values are Python, plugin values as typed in the form). needs = settings without a default that must be filled in, with a hint. adapt = input format the function needs (the block converts to it and back); the compatibility scan also finds these by itself. notes = shown in the block. Edit freely; the toolbox reads it every time it opens. prep = a step run before the function: scene_detect marks scene changes (vs-jetpack sc_detect) for filters that need them.

hide.vstools.split: returns several clips (one per plane) - use Custom code
hide.vstools.flatten_vnodes: returns a list of clips - use Custom code
hide.vstools.shift_clip_multi: returns a list of clips - use Custom code
hide.vstools.expect_bits: returns a clip and a bit depth, not a filter
hide.vstools.finalize_output: a decorator for scripts, not a filter
hide.vstools.initialize_input: a decorator for scripts, not a filter
hide.vstools.join: joins several clips - use Custom code
hide.vstools.stack_clips: stacks several clips - use Custom code
hide.vsmasktools.get_all_edge_detects: returns a list of masks - use Custom code
hide.vsmasktools.get_all_ridge_detect: returns a list of masks - use Custom code
hide.vsdenoise.frequency_merge: merges several clips - use Custom code
hide.std.SplitPlanes: returns several clips - use Custom code
hide.std.PropToClip: needs a frame stored in a frame property (from another filter) - use Custom code
hide.mv.Analyse: needs a super clip from mv.Super - use vsdenoise.mc_degrain or Custom code
hide.mv.Finest: needs a super clip from mv.Super - use Custom code
hide.mvu.Analyse: needs a super clip from mvu.Super - use Custom code
hide.mvu.AnalyseMany: needs a super clip from mvu.Super - use Custom code
hide.mvu.OcclusionMask: needs motion vectors from mvu.Analyse - use Custom code
hide.mvu.SADMask: needs motion vectors from mvu.Analyse - use Custom code
hide.mvu.VectorLengthMask: needs motion vectors from mvu.Analyse - use Custom code
hide.bm3d.OPP2RGB: only after bm3d.RGB2OPP + bm3d.Basic/Final (opponent colour) - use vsdenoise or Custom code
hide.composite.Decode: needs a composite (GRAY16) signal from composite.Encode - use Custom code
hide.akarin.DLISR: needs NVIDIA's DLISR runtime, which this PC's driver does not provide to VapourSynth
hide.std.DoubleWeave: needs fields from std.SeparateFields (field properties) - use Custom code
hide.vsdeinterlace.weave: needs fields from std.SeparateFields / vsdeinterlace.reweave input - use Custom code
hide.vszip.PackRGB: packs RGB into one 32-bit plane for other software - not a picture

needs.fmtc.matrix: mat: a matrix preset, e.g. 601 or 709
needs.fmtc.primaries: an RGB (linear) input and prims_in / prims_out
needs.fmtc.transfer: an RGB input and transs / transd
needs.placebo.Shader: shader: path of a .glsl shader file
needs.vsscale.pre_ss: function: the filter to run supersampled, e.g. vsrgtools.box_blur
needs.placebo.Tonemap: HDR -> SDR tonemapping: src_csp / dst_csp of an HDR source (not used for DVDs)

notes.zsmooth.TTempSmooth: scthresh 0 = no scene-change detection (that needs the miscfilters plugin); the app's Steady chain uses it the same way.
notes.vsdeinterlace.vinverse: Before IVTC (on the telecined / interlaced frames) or on frames with leftover combing.
notes.zsmooth.Cnr4: Scene changes are marked first (vs-jetpack sc_detect), so nothing is blended across a cut.
notes.vsmasktools.stabilize_mask: Scene changes are marked first (vs-jetpack sc_detect).
